svg.title: Recovery of uniform logarithmic remainder rates. For fixed coefficient sections, hZ n = jnhn and the section norm preserve the rate of every finite-reader difference. Applying a fixed linear map of norm C also preserves a rate: for a prescribed slack ε > 0, use the input estimate with slack ε/2 and then choose T so large that C ≤eεT/2. The same argument absorbs any fixed finite number of summands. Consequently the exact homogeneous map and finite remainder sum recover (OE4)–(OE5) with unchanged exponents, rather than a shifted grade.
